result:
{
  "title": "Leave Room in the Page",
  "intro": [
    "Teal mug by the map, dawn mist on the ridge,",
    "cream compass turned to the window, harbor bridge;",
    "Mira writes “Harborlight Camp” above the line—",
    "the sky won’t promise clear, so they leave it time."
  ],
  "verse1": [
    "Papa Bear checks the weather, trail notice, return;",
    "Mira packs the torch, water, notebook, warm layer.",
    "Two maps, same route; if the weather shifts, turn back.",
    "No shortcut gets a vote, no bright hillside distracts.",
    "At the board, she snaps the marked path for her file,",
    "checks wood against paper, then follows it a while.",
    "From shore, the footbridge looks short; from up high, long—",
    "she draws both views, marks where she stood; neither’s wrong.",
    "At camp, level ground; keep the footpath clear.",
    "Tripod feet checked, telescope cased till night is here.",
    "Mug weighs down the map; clip keeps the pages in place.",
    "One cloud veils the first star; she writes what she can trace."
  ],
  "chorus1": [
    "Write what the light allows, leave room in the page;",
    "name what you see, don’t pretend you know the range.",
    "The mug holds the map; the notes hold their ground.",
    "Wait for the sky—let the evidence come round."
  ],
  "verse2": [
    "Night settles in; she shields the lantern’s little flame,",
    "just enough glow for the mug, not enough to wash the frame.",
    "They wait till the sun’s last glow has gone from the view;",
    "then trade the eyepiece, look again, see what moved through.",
    "“Bright point,” says Mira—no distance guessed or claimed.",
    "Cloud shifts; harbor lights sharpen; ridge-band fades.",
    "A brief streak cuts the open sky, gone in a breath;",
    "no time to draw the whole arc, no grand tale left.",
    "They note its direction, rough time, momentary span;",
    "the page leaves a question where a guess might have began.",
    "For a while, no words; hands warm on the mug.",
    "“Waiting gave us this,” her last line, quiet and snug."
  ],
  "chorus2": [
    "Write what the light allows, leave room in the page;",
    "name what you saw, let the unknown keep its space.",
    "The mug holds the map; the notes hold their ground.",
    "Wait for the sky—now the streak’s in the account."
  ],
  "verse3": [
    "Before bed, they check each entry against the plan:",
    "place, weather, time, observer—clear to another hand.",
    "A sketch stays a sketch; an unsure name stays unsure;",
    "that’s how a stranger can read what the night made obscure.",
    "Morning: mug, clip, notebook, lantern, telescope case;",
    "Papa checks the campsite, leaves no scrap in its place.",
    "Same marked path to the harbor, no trace left behind;",
    "at the overlook, dawn gives the bridge a new line.",
    "Mira adds a third small drawing beside the first two;",
    "no erasure needed—the light changed the view.",
    "Back at the window, the teal mug rests by the map;",
    "four pages, three sketches: evidence first, then the gap."
  ],
  "bridge": [
    "Place: ridge. Time: night. Observer: Mira. Cloud moving.",
    "Streak: brief. Direction recorded. Distance—nothing.",
    "Morning: bridge, new angle. Old sketches still stand.",
    "The page doesn’t settle the sky; it shows where they’ve been."
  ],
  "chorus3": [
    "Write what the light allows, leave room in the page;",
    "three views, one bridge—each honest to its place.",
    "The mug holds the map; the notes show what changed.",
    "Describe what you know; let the rest stay unnamed."
  ]
}
